headline:
Explosive earnings beat,
now technically overbought
chart_note: 10-day range: $205.62 - $264.43, up 26.4% over the window - a huge post-earnings gap higher on Aug 27, now right at the 52-week high.
why_today: Up 2.9% today, extending a huge post-earnings gap higher from late August - now trading right at the 52-week high with RSI deep in overbought territory.
pro_1: Quarterly earnings up 118.9% YoY on 10.8% revenue growth - a major beat that reset the stock sharply higher
pro_2: PEG of 1.07 is reasonable for this growth rate, with strong analyst sentiment (40 of 56 Buy/Strong Buy)
con_1: RSI at 82 is deep into overbought territory, and the stock is trading just 1.4% below its 52-week high after a huge single-day gap - real pullback risk near-term
con_2: Beta of 1.15 combined with the sharp recent run-up means volatility could pick up if momentum cools
